paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Who authored the medical treatise "Kalyanakaraka"?
x: Ugraditya, a Jain resident of Ramatirtha, authored the medical treatise Kalyanakaraka. Somadevasuri wrote Yasastilaka and Neetivakyamrita.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: "Hariti" whose tutelary deity?
x: Goddess Hariti, protector of children, was the family deity of the Ikshvakus. Hariti and Mahasena were also worshipped by the Vengi Chalukyas.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Who bears the title "Kollabhiganda"?
x: Vijayaditya-IV, second son of Chalukya Bhima-I, had the title Kollabhiganda. He ruled only six months and was killed in the Kalinga invasion.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Which philosophical theory was propagated by Kumarila Bhattu?
x: Kumarila Bhatta popularized Jaimini's Purvamimamsa in Andhra. Uttara Mimamsa is attributed to Badarayana and Advaita to Adi Shankaracharya.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Which was the central location of trade center in medieval Andhra?
x: Trade associations were known as Nakarams. Penugonda in West Godavari district was the capital of the Nakaram.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Who propounded the theory that 'Andras and Satavahanas are not the same'?
x: V.S. Sukthankar proposed that the Andhras and Satavahanas were not the same, calling the Satavahanas 'Andhrabhrityas'. V.A. Smith and R.G. Bhandarkar held that the Satavahanas were Andhras.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Who formed the slave society in Andhra?
x: Brahmanaidu introduced Chapakudu (inter-dining) and gave Panchamas temple entry. His Veera Vaishnava movement increased the number of Dasaris among Panchamas.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: First inscription in Telugu?
x: The Kalamalla inscription (575 AD) of Renati Chola Dhananjaya Erikal Muthuraju in Kadapa district is the first Telugu inscription. It is a prose inscription.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: "Kayastha" is the caste of?
x: "Kayastha" is a caste of scribes.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Eastern Chalukya king who built 108 temples named Narendrasvaralayas?
x: Vijayaditya-II fought 108 battles in a twelve-year succession war with his brother Bhimasala and built 108 Narendramrigeshwara temples as atonement. His titles included Narendra Mrigaraja and Chalukyarama.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: "Mitaksharamu" was written as "Vignaneshwaram" in Telugu by whom?
x: Ketana wrote Vignaneshwariyam, the first Dharmashastra text in Telugu, based on Mitakshara. He also wrote Andhrabhasha Bhushanam, the first Telugu grammar.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Chalukya Mathematician Paavuluri Mallana's Agraharam?
x: Rajaraja Narendra gave Pavuluri Mallana the agrahara Navakhandavada for rendering Mahaviracharya's Ganita Sarasangraha into Telugu. Narayana Bhatta received Nandampudi.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: The first Muslim attack on Orugallu took place in which year?
x: The first invasion of Orugallu was in 1303 by Alauddin Khilji's forces under Fakhruddin Juna, and it was repulsed. Further invasions followed in 1309, 1316 and 1323.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Number of village headmen during Kakatiya period?
x: Ayagars, who received tax-free land for village and royal service, managed village administration. There were twelve Ayagars for each village.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Gangadevi was disciple of whom?
x: Ganga Devi was the disciple of Agastya.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Which Reddy king shifted his capital from Addanaki to Kondavidu?
x: According to the Manyamapura inscription (1364 AD), Anapota Reddy strengthened Kondaveedu fort and shifted the capital from Addanki to Kondaveedu.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Identify the non-Siddhatriya among the following?
x: The Siddha trayam are Revana, Marula and Ekorama. Udbhataradhya belongs to the Aradhya trayam.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Ikshvaku king who tried to make the intelligentsia partners in agricultural development?
x: Sri Santamula donated crores of gold coins, lakhs of ploughs and cows, and land for agricultural development. Hence he got the titles Sata Sahasra Halaka and Mahadanadhipati.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p51
s: Which Telugu scholar wrote the poem "Vikramarjana Vijayam" in Kannada?
x: Vikramarjuna Vijayam (Pampa Bharata) is a Kannada epic by the Jain poet Pampa, court poet of Chalukya Arikesari-II. Pampa, Ponna and Ranna are the three jewels of Kannada literature.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who built the lake of Arikesari Samudram?
x: Prolaraja-I built the Arikesari (Kesari) Samudram tank. Betaraja-II built Settike Samudram and Rudradeva built Rudra Samudram.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Ramappa temple belongs to which type?
x: Ramappa temple at Palampet was built in 1213 AD by Recharla Rudra, general of Ganapatideva, with Ramappa as architect. Its bricks float in water.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Number of caves in Bhairavakonda in Nellore district?
x: There are 8 caves at Bhairavakonda in Nellore district, all Shiva caves. Their lion-based pillars show Pallava influence.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: "Sangeetha - Sudhakaram" authored the text of musicology?
x: Singabhupala-II wrote Sangeetasudhakaram, a treatise on music.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who said that paper has been used for writing in the 15th century?
x: During the Reddy period, Srinatha mentioned paper in his writings. The paper may have been introduced by Muslims.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: The famous ship port town of Kakatiyas?
x: Motupalli was the famous Kakatiya port where Ganapatideva issued the Abhaya Sasanam (1244) protecting foreign traders. Marco Polo visited it in 1292.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: The rules to be followed in the construction of Tataka mentioned in?
x: The Porumamilla inscription by Bhaskara Bhavaduka lists twelve rules for tank (tataka) construction.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Kumaragiri Reddy's Court dancer?
x: Lakuma Devi, a master of Bharata Shastra, was the famous dancer in Kumaragiri Reddy's court. Kumaragiri wrote Vasantarajiyam, a Sanskrit work on dance.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: In which year did the Bobbili war take place?
x: The battle of Bobbili took place on 24 January 1757, when Vijayarama Raju besieged Bobbili with Bussy's French army. Tandra Paparayudu later killed Vijayarama Raju.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: In the spirit of Nanasaheb's rebellion, who led the rebellion in the Godavari Agency area?
x: Korukonda Subbareddy led a tribal revolt in the Godavari district as part of the 1857 rebellion and was captured and executed.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: In which year did Collectors administration come into force in place of Revenue Board?
x: The book's answer is 1794. Its explanation adds that the Collector system took effect in 1800 when Thomas Munro became Collector of the Ceded districts.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: In which year Dhavaleshwaram Dam was constructed?
x: The Dowleswaram dam on the Godavari was started in 1847 and completed in April 1852 under Arthur Cotton, with Veenam Veeranna playing a key role.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who is known as "Father of Harikatha"?
x: Adibhatla Narayanadasu is known as the father of Harikatha, which he popularized.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who authored the travelogue "Nilagiriyatra"?
x: The travelogue Nilagiriyatra was authored by Kola Seshachala Kavi.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who founded the magazine "Hasyavardhani"?
x: Kokkonda Venkata Ratnam Pantulu founded Hasyavardhini and Andhra Bhasha Sanjeevini to criticize Veeresalingam's views on women's education and remarriage.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Errapragada is the educational officer in which king's Court?
x: Errana was the court poet of Prolaya Vema Reddy and dedicated Harivamsa to him. Srinatha was the education officer of Peddakomati Vemareddy.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: Who described Joshua as a "MADHURAKAVI"?
x: Viswanatha Satyanarayana praised Gurram Joshua as "Madhura Kavi".

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p52
s: In which year the first widow remarriage was performed in Andhra?
x: Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage in Andhra on 11 December 1881 for Gogulapati Sriramulu and Seethamma.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Who praised Veeresalingam for his service to the community by calling him "South Indian Vidyasagar"?
x: At a social reform meeting in Madras in 1898 chaired by Veeresalingam, M.G. Ranade called him the Vidyasagar of South India.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Where was the first meeting of Krishna District Congress Association held?
x: The Krishna District Congress Committee, the first district-level Congress committee in India, was formed in July 1892 and held its first meeting at Guntur. Its second meeting was at Machilipatnam in 1893.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Tenali bomb case happened during this movement?
x: The Tenali bomb case (1909), a plot to blow up the Howrah Express near Tenali, occurred during the Vande Mataram movement.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: First political magazine published in Andhra?
x: Andhra Prakasika, founded in 1885 by Parthasarathi Naidu in Madras, was the first political magazine in Andhra.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Dattamandala was named as Rayalaseema by whom?
x: At the 1928 Nandyal Andhra Mahasabha presided over by S. Radhakrishnan, Gadicharla Harisarvottama Rao named the Datta Mandalam as Rayalaseema.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Who edited the journal "Brahma Prakasika"?
x: Brahma Prakasika was an English weekly edited by Raghupati Venkata Ratnam Naidu.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Who was the first Telugu woman to offer her jewelery to "Tilak Swarajya Fund" and burn foreign articles?
x: Influenced by Gandhi at the 1921 Vijayawada Congress meeting, Maganti Annapurnadevi wore khaddar and burnt foreign sarees.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: When did the Palnadu Pullari Satyagraha take place?
x: The Palnadu Pullari Satyagraha began in 1921 in Palnadu taluk of Guntur district against the grazing tax. Its leader Kanneganti Hanumanthu died in police firing.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: In which year 'Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam' was established in Secunderabad?
x: Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam in Secunderabad was founded in 1905 by Komarraju Lakshmana Rao.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Ramaswamy Chaudhary's "Veeragandhamu techhinaramu... veerulevvaro telpudee" Song given in which movement?
x: Tripuraneni Ramaswami Choudhary sang "Veeragandhamu techinaramu" to welcome the salt satyagrahis during the Civil Disobedience movement.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: "Nilgiri" magazine was published from?
x: Nilgiri was a weekly published from Nalgonda by Shabnavis Venkatarama Narasimha Rao from 24 August 1922.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: A direct battle between the British and the followers of Alluri Sitaramaraj took place here?
x: The first direct battle between the police and Alluri's revolutionaries took place on 3 September 1922 at Panjeri Ghat, where Alluri was victorious.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: "Andhrajana Kendra Sangam" was formed in 1923 at which place?
x: Andhrajana Kendra Sangam was formed at Hanamkonda in 1923.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Chanda Railway Scheme was proposed in the year?
x: The Chanda Railway scheme was proposed in 1883 to link the Singareni and Chanda coal fields. Changes to the scheme sparked Telangana consciousness.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: Who founded "Adi Hindu Social Service League"?
x: In 1911 Bhagya Reddy Varma formed the Hindu Social Service League in Hyderabad, part of the Adi Hindu self-respect movement of Dalits.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: In which year the Ban on Hyderabad State Congress was removed?
x: The ban on the Hyderabad State Congress was lifted in 1946.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p53
s: On which date did the Nizam and the Government of India sign the Standstill agreement?
x: The Nizam and the Government of India signed the Standstill Agreement on 29 November 1947.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: "Join Indian Union" movement leader?
x: Defying the Nizam's ban, Swami Ramananda Theertha hoisted the national flag at Sultan Bazar, Hyderabad on 15 August 1947.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who has the title "Telugu Lenka"?
x: Tummala Sitaramamurthy was popularly known as Telugu Lenka. His other title was Abhinava Tikkana.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who was the first Hyderabad Muslim leader to join the Indian National Congress?
x: Mulla Abdul Qayyum was the first Muslim leader from Hyderabad State to join the Indian National Congress, in 1885.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Andhra University was first established in which town?
x: Andhra University started at Vijayawada on 26 April 1926 with C.R. Reddy as Vice-Chancellor. It was later shifted to Waltair (Visakhapatnam).

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: "Shribagh" is his residence?
x: Sri Bagh was the Madras residence of Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao, where the Sri Bagh Pact was signed on 16 November 1937.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Wanchu committee formed for?
o: for the identification of problems in the formation of the state
To convince the Nizam to join the Indian Union
To make suggestions for the development of education in Hyderabad State
x: The Centre appointed the Kailas Nath Wanchoo Committee on 7 February 1953 to examine financial, territorial and administrative issues of forming Andhra State. It reported on 25 March 1953.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who became the Chief Minister of Andhra State after the 1955 elections?
x: After President's Rule (November 1954 - March 1955), Bezawada Gopala Reddy was Chief Minister of Andhra State from March 1955 to 31 October 1956.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who led the delegation formed to raise the Hyderabad issue before the Security Council?
x: Moin Nawaz Jung led the delegation that raised the Hyderabad issue before the UN Security Council.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: The book "Hyderabad in Retrospect" is authored by?
x: The book "Hyderabad in Retrospect" was written by Aliyavar Jung.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Hyderabad State Comrades Association was established in which year?
x: The Comrades Association was established in Hyderabad State in 1940.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: In 1939 who established "Rajakeeya Pathashala" at Kankipadu?
x: N.G. Ranga established a Rajakeeya Pathashala at Kankipadu in 1939 and also ran a political school at his village Nidubrolu.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who started Vishalandrodyamam?
x: The Communists, led by Puchalapalli Sundarayya, campaigned for Visalandhra from 1946. Sundarayya wrote 'Visalandhra lo Praja Rajyam' explaining its benefits.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: In which year the foundation stone of Nagarjuna Sagar project was laid?
x: Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru laid the foundation stone of the Nagarjuna Sagar project on 10-12-1955.

paper: Paper-II: Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p54
s: Who was the first/ Founder of Andhra Pradesh State Legislative Assembly?
x: Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao was the first Speaker of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly. Madapati Hanumantha Rao was the first Legislative Council Chairman.
